releaseNotes: V892 hardens LIVE Refresh output continuity for VPN/NIC route conditions. While Studio Runtime is LIVE, repeated Refresh clicks no longer cancel an in-flight runtime-safe REST identity request; extra clicks are coalesced.

Each completed or non-fatal failed LIVE runtime-safe Refresh publishes an output-continuity edge. The PLC Runtime observes that edge and reasserts only the currently ACTIVE Signal Tower PDO image through the existing PdoOutputCoordinator after the existing connected-state, VID/DID, configuration-transition and ISDU-idle guards pass.

V891 Required Output Transport Hold, V890 reconnect-edge recovery, Background Identity NOOP, LIVE Refresh engineering isolation, SerialCommandQueue ownership and PdoOutputCoordinator single-writer semantics remain unchanged.
No changes were made to Runtime/Connectivity, Runtime/Isdu, Runtime/Polling, Runtime/LowLevel, Services/IoLink/Pdi, PdoOutputCoordinator, IoddAutoDownloadService or SignalTowerPresetRuntimeService.

en: LIVE Refresh no longer cancels an in-flight runtime-safe REST identity request; repeated clicks are coalesced.
After a LIVE Refresh completes or fails non-fatally, the current ACTIVE Signal Tower PDO is reasserted through the existing PdoOutputCoordinator with the existing physical-identity and safety guards.
V891 transport hold and all protected low-level runtime paths remain unchanged.
ko: Studio Runtime이 LIVE일 때 진행 중인 runtime-safe REST identity Refresh를 새 Refresh 클릭이 취소하지 않으며, 연속 클릭은 coalesce됩니다.
LIVE Refresh가 완료되거나 비치명적으로 실패하면 현재 ACTIVE Signal Tower PDO만 기존 PdoOutputCoordinator를 통해 물리 identity/안전 가드 확인 후 재확정합니다.
V891 transport hold와 보호된 저수준 Runtime 경로는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: Studio Runtime が LIVE の間、進行中の runtime-safe REST identity Refresh を新しい Refresh クリックでキャンセルせず、連続クリックは coalesce します。
LIVE Refresh の完了または非致命的失敗後、現在 ACTIVE の Signal Tower PDO のみを既存 PdoOutputCoordinator 経由で物理 identity / safety guard 確認後に再 assert します。
V891 transport hold と保護済み low-level Runtime 経路は変更していません。
zh-CN: Studio Runtime 为 LIVE 时，新的 Refresh 点击不再取消正在进行的 runtime-safe REST identity Refresh，连续点击会被合并。
LIVE Refresh 完成或非致命失败后，仅通过现有 PdoOutputCoordinator 在物理 identity / safety guard 通过后重新确认当前 ACTIVE Signal Tower PDO。
V891 transport hold 与受保护的底层 Runtime 路径保持不变。
de: Während Studio Runtime LIVE ist, bricht ein weiterer Refresh-Klick einen laufenden runtime-safe REST-Identity-Refresh nicht mehr ab; Mehrfachklicks werden zusammengefasst.

Nach Abschluss oder nichtfatalem Fehler eines LIVE Refresh wird nur das aktuell ACTIVE Signal-Tower-PDO über den bestehenden PdoOutputCoordinator und die vorhandenen Physical-Identity-/Safety-Guards erneut geschrieben.
V891 Transport Hold und alle geschützten Low-Level-Runtime-Pfade bleiben unverändert.
es: Con Studio Runtime en LIVE, un nuevo clic en Refresh ya no cancela una solicitud runtime-safe REST identity en curso; los clics repetidos se agrupan.

Tras completar o fallar de forma no fatal un LIVE Refresh, solo se reafirma el PDO ACTIVE actual de Signal Tower mediante el PdoOutputCoordinator existente y sus guards de identidad física y seguridad.
El transport hold de V891 y todas las rutas Runtime de bajo nivel protegidas permanecen sin cambios.
